title.zh: 核心作为智慧之根的目标
title.en: Core as the root of wisdom target

claim.zh: 待完成：证明 core 的共同关系对所讨论的全部智慧不可省略，从而确立整个 core 的根基地位。已有内容保真、实际取得与使用、后果修订及受支持持续的条件成果直接复用；不以这些局部完成代替全称结论。
claim.en: Open: establish the indispensability of the core’s common relations across all wisdom under discussion and thereby the foundational status of the whole core. Reuse completed conditional fidelity, acquisition/use, consequence-driven revision and supported continuation without substituting them for the universal conclusion.

hypotheses.zh: 保留获授权的必要关系与生成解释两部分；不能将局部成功条件改名为完整智慧。
hypotheses.en: Retain both authorized components, necessary relations and generative explanation; local success conditions cannot simply be renamed full wisdom.

hypotheses.zh: 按 Ren 的纠正，以道德评价 becoming、普遍生成原则支撑具体判断为正面路线，不以对手认可为门槛。当前第二部分由 Unrestricted 推出 G0；相应 A、L、J／C、实践解释及真实对应 E 明示，不把它们作为裸动力学的结论。
hypotheses.en: Following Ren’s correction, pursue morality as appraisal of becoming through universal generative principles, without requiring a rival’s assent. Current Part II derives G0 from Unrestricted; the applicable A, L, J/C, practical articulation and actual correspondence E remain explicit, not conclusions of bare dynamics.

correspondence.zh: 第15节保留八种道德判断；第16节从独立内容、根据、范围与强度连接五类智慧与既有形式条件；第17节核对隐性实践并区分描述省略与实际转化；第18节接通有根据的放下与结束：共同支持改变和注意／体验改变分别解释，原需要、实际接续、完成与解除不能被删去。必要关系不要求显式规则、最大信息、永久修订或每个旧形式的保存。 第19节接通理论智慧，区分内容成立、认识根据和理解形成；提出内容—根据、根据—实际把握、把握—所称接续的候选共同联系，分列分支前提，并以旧联合解释／闭包定理定位全范围证明的负担。 第20节以偶然发现后读懂证明、直接领会及冗余根据检验实际把握，排除可靠来源或逐项不可替代因果链的过强读法；既有习得绑定定位内容如何进入解释与执行。 第21节用既有同值误接与代入结果定位所声称的内容依存；分开全部使用保真、特定成就的必要关系与核心路径接合，明确粗读法的接合不自行认证内容根据。 第25节接入 P103：P99 的实际操作产出直接进入后继修订；同一运行既继续指定任务又退役旧区别。构成性绑定、习得内容与持续支承按其关系分工；不同实例间的智慧对应为解释性复用，不伪称状态已形式接合。 第26节消费原有限可错辨别与及时回应结果：独立覆盖／错误承诺仍约束差异的实际进入，允许不同内部描述、错误和暂缓；原抽象界与原生物理实现条件分开。 第27节接通非统计成就：理论内容与实际把握、观照的实际生活改变、完成与解除分别定位；一般Frame的G0及relevance_least已容纳当下实现，原可能性／在场／休息边界防止用未来可行性或活动数量替换这些内容。 §28消费已有共同操作因子：同一接合内容的不同精确说明有不可绕开的共同内容，源说明不必最简；多结果保留更丰富问题与有限性。原历史界面证明同时定位接续问题不能独自保留的内部事件，故须与原内容、根据及实际把握在同一解释中接通。 §29通过三项纯核心适配将P91保真接到P69同一内容／步骤关系。反向只在R联系处要求保真，不组合独立的后继见证。原绑定、实际历史与规范论证负责所用主张的真实内容；纯形式接口不再作为缺失机制。 §30固定替代行动判断的内容，以P53/P68/P80区别实际记录、有根据的规律及由其生成的回应；静态表达保留关系时得到同等信用。 §31接用既有内容与理由研究，修正§19候选共同关系的适用读法：可错接受实际承接的是有根据的支持，不必是使所信结论为真的充分根据。知识、合理接受、实践许可与后续责任分别说明，不以终点真假替代历史根据。
correspondence.en: Section 15 retains eight moral applications; Section 16 connects independently specified content, grounds, scope and strength to formal conditions across five wisdom aspects. Section 17 examines tacit practice and separates descriptive omission from actual transformation. Section 18 connects warranted letting-go and ending: changes in shared support and in attention/experience are distinguished, while need, actual continuation, fulfillment and discharge cannot be erased. Necessary relations require neither explicit rules, maximal information, perpetual revision nor preservation of every old form. Section 19 connects theoretical wisdom, separating content validity, epistemic warrant and formed understanding. Candidate common relations connect content/grounds, grounds/actual grasp and grasp/claimed continuation; branch premises are separated and old joint-interpretation/closure results locate the universal proof burden. Section 20 tests actual grasp through chance discovery followed by proof understanding, direct apprehension and redundant grounds. It rejects reliable origins or individually indispensable causal routes as universal requirements and locates content use in existing acquired binding. Section 21 locates attributed content dependence through inherited equal-value capture and substitution results. It separates preservation of all consumers, necessity for a particular achievement and core path composition; composition under a coarse reading does not certify its content grounds. Section 25 consumes P103: P99 operations directly feed successor revision, while the same run continues specified tasks and retires old distinctions. Constitutive binding, acquired content and continuing support retain their separate roles. Wisdom correspondence across different instances is interpretive, not a purported formal state composition. Section 26 consumes existing finite fallible discrimination and timely response: independent coverage/error commitments still constrain the actual entry of differences, allowing different internal descriptions, errors and abstention. The abstract bound and native physical conditions remain separate. Section 27 connects non-statistical achievements: theoretical content and actual grasp, lived change in contemplation, and fulfillment/release. General-Frame G0 and relevance_least already accommodate present realization; original possibility/presence/rest boundaries prevent replacing this content with future feasibility or activity counts. Section 28 consumes existing common operational factors: exact accounts of the same joining content retain unavoidable shared content without source minimality. Multivalued recovery keeps richer questions and finiteness. The history-interface result identifies internal events that continuation questions alone can omit, requiring a joint connection to content, grounds and actual uptake. Section 29 joins P91 fidelity to P69 joint content/step preservation through three pure-core adapters. Reflection needs fidelity only where R relates configurations, without combining independent successor witnesses. Binding, actual history and normative arguments supply real claim content; this formal interface is no longer a missing mechanism. Section 30 fixes the content of alternative-action judgment and uses P53/P68/P80 to distinguish records, warranted laws and generated responses; static expressions retaining the relations receive equal credit. Section 31 consumes existing content/reasons arguments to correct the section 19 candidate: fallible acceptance takes up warranted support, not necessarily a sufficient ground of the accepted proposition’s truth. Knowledge, reasonable acceptance, practical permission and subsequent responsibility remain distinct; final truth does not replace historical warrant.

detail.zh: 既有G0/J普遍原则解释保留、转化、交接和结束的共同根据；第14节作哲学复用，不新增规范公理或Lean连接。 §31保持认识许可与实践许可的区别，以及错误后的残余责任；不以有限接受自动解除J4要求。
detail.en: Existing G0/J principles explain the common grounds of preservation, transformation, transfer and ending; section 14 reuses them philosophically without a new normative axiom or Lean adapter. Section 31 preserves the distinction between epistemic and practical permission and residual responsibility after error; fallible acceptance does not automatically discharge J4.

detail.zh: 既有C条件下的关系信息必要性支撑模型须保留共同生成差别的论证；不证明全部伦理根基。
detail.en: The existing C-dependent information necessity supports retaining joint-generative differences in appraisal; it does not prove the entire ethical foundation.

detail.zh: 既有G0下的正面未来根据表明，生成形态开放与有根据的评价可以并存；不把正面方面升级为最终许可。
detail.en: The existing G0-based positive-future ground supports appraisal with open generative form; a positive aspect is not upgraded to final permission.

detail.zh: 复用完成的形式支撑，接到第16节独立陈述的智慧内容；对应是解释，不新增形式组合。
detail.en: Reuse completed formal support for the independently described wisdom content in Section 16; the correspondence is interpretive, not a new formal composition.

detail.zh: 有界识别与稳定正确限定“智慧必须永久修订”的过强读法。
detail.en: Bounded identification and stable correctness limit the overstrong reading that wisdom must revise perpetually.

detail.zh: 已有保持所识未来与常值描述边界，用于第17节的内容保真检验；不主张实际忘却已由投影定理解释。
detail.en: Existing registered-future preservation and the constant-description boundary inform Section 17’s content test; actual forgetting is not claimed explained by projection theorems.

detail.zh: §§23–24八项已检查适配直接调用：最低所需范围与任意Frame成立状态的判据分别保留。形式依赖仅及接通命题，不宣称普遍慧根已证。 §29再以原RespectsAt恢复同一互模拟中的主张，三个适配直接接到P69，形式范围不扩大为实际智慧证明。
detail.en: Eight checked adapters in Sections 23–24 directly reuse the source: requirement-profile and arbitrary-Frame realization criteria retain separate scopes. Formal reuse concerns the connecting claims, not completed universal wisdom-root necessity. Section 29 additionally uses RespectsAt to recover claims in the same bisimulation, with three direct P69 adapters; this formal scope is not an actual-wisdom proof.

output.zh: 接纳保真与最低所需剖面的精确条件，及 Frame 内容恢复。
output.en: Exact admission fidelity and minimum-requirement criterion, plus Frame content recovery.

input.zh: 供应所需剖面同一与分组保真，作为 Through 保留的关系前件。 在R所联系的配置上供应内容保真，使归并前后该同一R为互模拟等价。
input.en: Supply profile identity and regrouping fidelity as the relational premises for Through preservation. Supply fidelity at R-related configurations to preserve and reflect that same bisimulation after regrouping.

conditions.zh: 原Frame/Web、所问内容与分组；最低所需分支要求可判定性，任意Frame成立状态分支不要求。跨配置选择与同一配置中的主张选择不混用；不推出完整意义、实际算法或普遍智慧归属。
conditions.en: Original Frame/Web, specified content and grouping. The requirement-profile branch needs decidability; arbitrary-Frame status does not. Keep selections across configurations distinct from selections among claims at a configuration; no complete semantics, executable algorithm or universal wisdom attribution is derived.

detail.zh: 习得绑定进入解释与实际执行，并保留错误绑定及解释／执行之别；第20节用于定位实际内容作用，不认领完整语义或新形式组合。
detail.en: Acquired bindings enter interpretation and execution while wrong binding and the interpretation/execution distinction remain. Section 20 locates operative content without claiming full semantics or a new formal composition.

detail.zh: 原代入的全使用／全位置等价及同值误接检验所称内容依存；仅解释性应用，不是新的组合证明。
detail.en: The existing all-consumer/all-position equivalence and equal-value capture test attributed content dependence; interpretive application only, not a new composition proof.

detail.zh: 复用局部构成性根据；其更强的零前提元逻辑目标保持独立，不追加为慧根必要关系门槛。
detail.en: Reuse local constitutive warrant while keeping the stronger premise-free metalogical goal separate from wisdom necessity.

detail.zh: 复用活动、配置及动作保留，核对 Frame.world 不直接承载原生支持／交换的接口范围。
detail.en: Reuse realization, configuration and move preservation while auditing the native support/exchange scope of Frame.world.

detail.zh: 复用 World.ofRoles 及生起／止息接口；共同类型的表示不独自证明智慧根基。
detail.en: Reuse World.ofRoles and arising/ceasing interfaces; a shared representation does not itself establish wisdom-root necessity.

detail.zh: 复用角色嵌入的支持、更新、消耗和交换保留，并保留原角色同一的界限。
detail.en: Reuse the role embedding’s support, renewal, consumption and exchange preservation, retaining its role-identification boundary.

detail.zh: §§23–24八项已检查适配直接调用：最低所需范围与任意Frame成立状态的判据分别保留。形式依赖仅及接通命题，不宣称普遍慧根已证。
detail.en: Eight checked adapters in Sections 23–24 directly reuse the source: requirement-profile and arbitrary-Frame realization criteria retain separate scopes. Formal reuse concerns the connecting claims, not completed universal wisdom-root necessity.

output.zh: 经等价关系的所有旧选择保留恰当新关系细化；合并区别的遗失见证。
output.en: All old selections through an equivalence survive exactly under refinement; a loss witness for merged distinctions.

input.zh: 消费 P91 的所需剖面关系，推出保留选择与接纳保真的等价及遗失见证。
input.en: Consume P91 requirement-profile relations to connect selection preservation with admission fidelity and specialize the loss witness.

conditions.zh: 原Frame/Web、所问内容与分组；最低所需分支要求可判定性，任意Frame成立状态分支不要求。跨配置选择与同一配置中的主张选择不混用；不推出完整意义、实际算法或普遍智慧归属。
conditions.en: Original Frame/Web, specified content and grouping. The requirement-profile branch needs decidability; arbitrary-Frame status does not. Keep selections across configurations distinct from selections among claims at a configuration; no complete semantics, executable algorithm or universal wisdom attribution is derived.

detail.zh: 直接复用共同 Process/Trace/Through 上已经完成的取得、修订、安装及实际使用；不重开原机制。
detail.en: Directly reuse completed acquisition, revision, installation and actual use on the shared Process/Trace/Through; do not reopen the mechanism.

detail.zh: 直接复用同一实现见证到正面相关的已完成正式桥接；公开完成对应与 Unrestricted，不泛称仍缺规范连接。
detail.en: Directly reuse the completed formal bridge from the same realization witness to positive relevance; disclose completion correspondence and Unrestricted rather than calling the normative link generically missing.

detail.zh: §25消费已完成的实际形成、受支持持续及旧区别退役；P99→P103的内部连接已形式检查。本记录不将该过程直接等同智慧或伦理实例。
detail.en: Section 25 consumes completed formation, supported continuation and retired distinctions; the internal P99→P103 connection is formally checked. This record does not identify the process outright with wisdom or an ethical instance.

output.zh: 从空参考形成接到一个实际无限运行；每轮修订、成功使用、回返、更替及旧区别损失。
output.en: Formation from empty reference joins one actual infinite run, with revision, successful use, productive return, succession and loss of an old distinction.

input.zh: 慧根论证中取得、使用与所称接续的关系，以及全选择保留是否必要的检验。
input.en: Relations between acquisition, use and attributed continuation in the wisdom argument, and the test of whether all-choice preservation is necessary.

conditions.zh: P103指定的可靠接触、任务政策、开放生产和更替条件；独立智慧内容及规范对应不由运行本身供应。
conditions.en: P103’s faithful contacts, task policy, open production and succession conditions; independent wisdom content and normative correspondence are not supplied by the run itself.

detail.zh: §26消费已完成证明，检验独立智慧能力承诺中的可错辨别及关系条件；原成果内部形式组合保持，本记录不将全部智慧定义为该统计任务。
detail.en: Section 26 consumes completed proofs for fallible discrimination and relational conditions in independent wisdom-capacity claims. Original internal formal compositions remain credited; this record does not define all wisdom as that statistical task.

output.zh: 有限可错辨别的覆盖／错误必要界及其已检查动态或及时关系组合。
output.en: Necessary finite coverage/error bounds and their checked adaptive or timely-relational compositions.

input.zh: 原慧根仅凭全分支正确保证不足以覆盖的可错能力声明。
input.en: Fallible capacity claims not covered by the wisdom argument’s perfect-answer guarantees alone.

conditions.zh: 实际二项对比、完整输入、有限自然权重和原能力界；及时分支另需其原前缀平衡、共同初态、登记及回应条件。理论理解、观照与规范意义不由错误界定义。
conditions.en: Actual binary contrast, complete input, finite natural weights and the declared capacity bounds; the timed branch additionally needs its prefix-balance, common-start, registration and response conditions. Error bounds do not define theoretical understanding, contemplation or normative significance.

detail.zh: §26消费已完成证明，检验独立智慧能力承诺中的可错辨别及关系条件；原成果内部形式组合保持，本记录不将全部智慧定义为该统计任务。

detail.en: Section 27 consumes the existing result to relate present achievement and future possibilities, without reproving it or certifying a supplied reading as all wisdom or experience.

output.zh: 一般Frame在Unrestricted下的G0及最小正面相关，精确包括已实现的living内容。
output.en: General-Frame G0 under Unrestricted and its least positive relevance, exactly including realized living content.

input.zh: 领会、观照与合宜结束的实际内容及其意义，不附加未来产出条件。
input.en: Actual content and significance in apprehension, contemplation and appropriate ending, without an extra productive-sequel condition.

conditions.en: Disclose the Frame, living reading and actual correspondence; normative inferences retain Unrestricted and applicable practical commitments. Possibility/activity ranking examples test supplied readings without generating experience or establishing universal wisdom necessity.

output.zh: 同一原生历程的接纳／实际在场差异，以及以更多活动破同分把停歇排低的边界。
output.en: Admission/presence differences on native courses and the rest boundary of activity-based tie breaking.

detail.en: Section 28 consumes the completed common-structure proof and audits its content scope in the wisdom argument; no new formal composition.

output.zh: 精确接合说明的共同因子；唯一结果、精确与约简下的共同操作。
output.en: A common factor for exact joining accounts; a common operation under functional joining, exactness and reducedness.

input.zh: 同一智慧解释中操作关系、内容根据与实际把握的共同必要性。
input.en: Joint necessity of operational relations, content/grounds and actual uptake in one wisdom explanation.

conditions.en: Correspondence of joining and question scope is required; exactness, reducedness and functional or finite outcomes enter only where stated. Semantic completeness is not personal omniscience, and the factor does not certify actual history or normative significance.

input.en: Joint necessity of operational relations, content/grounds and actual uptake in one wisdom explanation.

conditions.zh: 原接合及问题范围须对应；精确、约简、唯一或有限结果只在原定理要求处使用。不将语义完整性当作个人全知，不由共同因子认证实际历史或规范意义。
conditions.en: Correspondence of joining and question scope is required; exactness, reducedness and functional or finite outcomes enter only where stated. Semantic completeness is not personal omniscience, and the factor does not certify actual history or normative significance.

detail.zh: §29三个适配直接消费P69的Bisimulation和Alike定义，与P91归并保真连接；形式信用仅及这三项接口。
detail.en: Section 29 directly consumes P69 Bisimulation and Alike in three adapters connecting them to P91 fidelity; formal credit is limited to these interfaces.

output.zh: 同一个关系同时保留主张成立与步骤后继，以及由其给出的Alike。
output.en: One relation matching realized claims and successor steps, and the Alike relation it witnesses.

input.zh: 归并保留原R；相关位置保真时反射原R；全局保真时保持和反射Alike。
input.en: Regrouping retains R; related-state fidelity reflects R; global fidelity preserves and reflects Alike.

conditions.zh: 同一动作和原主张词汇、同一分组；两侧原过程不变。恢复需要声明的保真条件，不给出原读法的实际充分性或规范根据。
conditions.en: Shared actions and original claim vocabulary, one grouping and unchanged processes. Reflection needs the stated fidelity, without deriving actual adequacy or normative warrant.

detail.zh: §29消费原检验恢复与Choosing边界，不重证分支恢复或把反例称作智慧失败。
detail.en: Section 29 consumes original test recovery and the Choosing boundary, without reproving branching recovery or calling the witness a wisdom failure.

output.zh: 相同之下确定时从线性检验恢复同一关系；Choosing在无此条件时同测但不相同。
output.en: Linear tests recover likeness under determinacy up to likeness; Choosing agrees on tests without likeness when this condition is absent.

input.zh: 区别逐项存在的历程与同一后继关系，核对共同保留的强度。
input.en: Distinguish separately possible courses from one successor-matching relation and audit joint preservation strength.

conditions.zh: 保留原Frame与检验范围；Choosing没有主张，其见证关乎分支时机而非实际认知。
conditions.en: Retain original Frames and tests; Choosing has no claims and concerns branch timing, not actual cognition.

detail.zh: §30消费记录与模型固定性的区别，检验静态说明；不把自由重定向当成满足完整实际规律的反例。
detail.en: Section 30 uses record/model fixation to assess a static account, without treating unrestricted retargeting as a rival satisfying every actual law.

output.zh: 未取配置—动作的结果不由记录单独固定；指定模型固定其结果。
output.en: A record alone does not fix an untaken configuration/move; the specified model fixes its outcome.

input.zh: 核对关于替代行动的判断是否只诉诸实际记录，或还保留有根据的规律。
input.en: Check whether an alternative-action judgment relies only on records or also retains warranted laws.

conditions.zh: 原确定过程候选类、未取组合及两个不同配置；没有导出实际律、概率许可或普遍智慧定义。
conditions.en: Original determined candidate class, untaken pair and two distinct configurations; no derivation of the actual law, probabilistic permission or universal wisdom definition.

detail.zh: §30将P80共同律产生的替代历程接到生成评价，给保留这些关系的静态说明完整信用。
detail.en: Section 30 feeds P80 shared-law alternative courses into generative appraisal and credits static accounts retaining those relations.

output.zh: 可行替代行动的历程及回应由同一律产生；行动可在过程内形成，原Loop的两种进程被相应行动固定。
output.en: A shared law generates feasible alternative courses and responses; action can form within the process, and the original Loop courses are fixed by their acts.

input.zh: 供给道德判断becoming所比较的接续内容，不再自由供给第二流。
input.en: Supply the continuation content compared in moral appraisal of becoming, without freely supplying a second flow.

conditions.zh: 原非预知、平衡、可行、共同初态与在场条件；比较保留经识及意义覆盖；实际对应与G0/A/L/J/E另明示。
conditions.en: Original nonanticipation, balance, feasibility, common start and presence; comparison retains registration and significance coverage; actual correspondence and G0/A/L/J/E remain explicit.

detail.zh: 已完成候选有自己的有限智慧范围；不能自动升级为本目标。
detail.en: The completed candidate has its own bounded wisdom scope, which does not automatically satisfy this target.

detail.zh: 局部结果修正必要性检验强度，不构成整个根基的形式转换或完成证明。
detail.en: The local result corrects the strength of the necessity test; it is not a formal adapter or completion proof for the full root.

detail.zh: 完成本目标的形式部分：识、理（Ren 的读法）、检验、学习与推广、经识的选择与训练、够、失控、判断与元层次的规律对每个学习者与每个表示成立，不用公理。
detail.en: Completes this target's formal part: the laws of registration, 理 (Ren's reading), testing, learning and generalization, selection and training, enough, runaway, judgment and the meta level hold of every learner and every representation, with no axiom.

detail.zh: 足够描述不自动有仍充分的共同最粗表示。
detail.en: Sufficient descriptions need not admit a still-sufficient common coarsest representation.

detail.zh: 正确风险界限可伴随实际失败，不能用逐次必胜界定全部智慧。
detail.en: A true risk bound can accompany actual failure; infallible success cannot simply define all wisdom.

detail.zh: 第12–14节的智慧范围与普遍原则路线保留。第15节指出既有固定选择器在不可比情形中的默认分支只满足非支配要求，不能升级为独优；构造例与已有数学结果也不能替代现实对应或历史覆盖。
detail.en: Sections 12–14 retain differentiated wisdom and the universal-principle route. Section 15 clarifies that the fixed selector’s default in incomparable cases meets nondomination without unique superiority; constructed applications and existing mathematical results do not substitute for actual correspondence or historical coverage.

limitations.zh: P75 的普遍形式规律与形成路线保持完成；第16节补上内容敏感的解释连接，仍未穷尽独立智慧范围或证明每种智慧需要整个 core 的全部实质承诺。实际形成、关切与情感、充分性保留为完整目标的另外部分，不全部设为本次必要关系的新增门槛。真实风险界限容许实际失败；足够回应不要求共同最粗描述；形式全称量词不自动证明智慧覆盖。 对局部熟练联系的保留不证明全部 core 已被对手接受；坐忘没有被化约为判断或压缩算法。投影定理不证明实际遗忘有益。 第18节完成一种转化内容的解释连接，未穷尽坐忘或全部智慧；安宁无需外部收益，合宜结束不要求个体无限延续。分组保真检验说明中的内容，不能成为实际转化须无损保留一切的要求。 三项共同联系尚不是穷尽定义或最小公理表；内容成立不等于有人理解，解释保真不自动证明现实构成必然。原闭包结果没有供应智慧对应；有限根的整个闭合理论逐项可解释与仅根的各行分别可解释不能混同。 必要联系不规定发现路线；偶然来源可接到后续核验，直接领会不须显式演算，冗余根据可替代。习得绑定的操作意义、分类与覆盖仍给定；有效推导与实际内容使用并列不自动建立两者的统一必要性。 全部项的保真判据不能移为每次智慧保留全部位置的要求；形式绑定不等同实际人的理解。内容依存与路径接合之间本轮仅作解释性接通，没有新适配器；全部元推理的零前提正当化是另一目标，不追加为本任务门槛。 第25节排除全选择保留作为 P103 已证操作成就的必要要求，未把该成就定义为智慧或证明所有智慧可失去任意区别。退休位置未来再次被需要时，当前结果不保证回应或重新取得；持续修订及其生产回返不自行确立内容根据或伦理目的。 可错能力的必要界不认证实际权重、不构成伦理许可或错误信念的完整正当性，也不规定所有智慧都承担双侧错误承诺。及时分支不覆盖不同信息初态；理论理解与观照中不含此辨别承诺的内容，仍须其自身构成论证。 当下实现接口不认证特定体验、living读法或总体排序；休息见证未表示安宁体验，不是实际休息更坏的证据。三个非统计分支已获有内容的解释连接，不再因缺乏额外产出而列为未处理；其共同关系为何要求整个实质core，仍不能由可表示性或分别适用的读法推出。全部数学本体论及体验生成并非本次额外门槛。 共同操作因子并非全部智慧内容的充分根：原历史实例允许全部接合问题同答而事件字不同。此为指定问题范围的边界，完整core仍保留历史。精确完整解释的量词不转成每位智慧者的全知；规范意义及真实对应保持原责任。 新适配只改所用内容分组，保留两个过程、动作词汇及同一R。共用主张类型不等于意义已充分说明；可能历程不认证实际获得历史，也不推出义务。P76确定性条件与Choosing空主张边界保持；全慧根不由形式共同保留自动完成。 记录不固定性的候选类没有保留一切实际规律，不能据此否定完整理论。Loop不认证道德优越或现实社会规律；不把反事实推理普遍强加给理论领会、观照与结束。 可错接受沿既有认识候选及其可争论前提，不由G0或错误率定理独自推出。构造档案例明确供应证据充分性，未证明所有合理信念都是智慧；原命题错误不被改写成知识，也不自动免责。
limitations.en: P75’s universal formal laws and routes of formation remain completed; Section 16 supplies a content-sensitive interpretive connection, without exhausting independently characterized wisdom or proving that every form requires all substantive commitments of the core. Actual formation, concern and affect, and sufficiency remain distinct parts of the full target, not additional gates imposed wholesale on the present necessity task. A true risk bound allows actual failure; adequate response need not require a common coarsest description; formal universal quantification does not itself prove wisdom coverage. Preserving local skill relations does not establish that the rival accepts the full core; sitting-and-forgetting is not reduced to judgment or compression. Projection theorems do not prove that actual forgetting is beneficial. Section 18 supplies one transformation-content connection, not an exhaustive account of sitting-and-forgetting or wisdom. Tranquility needs no external payoff and appropriate ending requires no indefinite individual continuation. Fidelity concerns explanatory content, not a demand that transformation preserve everything without loss. The three common relations are not an exhaustive definition or minimal axiom list. Content validity is not actual understanding, and explanatory fidelity does not alone prove constitutive necessity. The old closure results supply no wisdom correspondence; full pointwise closure coverage for a finite root differs from separate coverage of basis rows. No acquisition route is universally prescribed: chance origins may be followed by verification, direct apprehension need not use explicit calculation, and redundant grounds may substitute. Acquired binding retains supplied meanings, categories and coverage; juxtaposing valid derivation with actual content use does not establish their joint necessity. The all-term fidelity criterion is not a requirement that each wise episode preserve every position, and formal binding is not actual human understanding. This round connects content dependence and path composition interpretively, without a new adapter. Premise-free warrant for all metareasoning remains a separate goal, not an added gate here. Section 25 rules out all-choice preservation as necessary for P103’s proved operational achievement; it neither defines that achievement as wisdom nor licenses arbitrary losses for all wisdom. Renewed demand for a retired locus is not covered by a recovery guarantee. Continuing revision and productive return do not alone establish content warrant or ethical purpose. Fallible-capacity necessity neither certifies actual weights nor supplies ethical permission or a complete justification of false belief. It does not require every wisdom claim to undertake two-sided error bounds. The timed branch excludes different informative initial states; theoretical or contemplative content without this discrimination commitment retains its own constitutive burden. The present-realization interface does not certify a particular experience, living reading or overall ranking. The rest witness omits tranquil experience and does not show actual rest to be worse. The three non-statistical branches now have substantive interpretive connections and are not left unaddressed for lacking extra output. Their joint requirement of the full substantive core still does not follow from representability or separately suitable readings. Complete mathematical ontology and experience generation are not added gates. A common operational factor is not a sufficient root for all wisdom content: the original history instance agrees on every joining context despite different event words. This bounds the question scope; the full core retains the histories. Exact explanatory coverage is not an omniscience demand on each wise person; normative and actual correspondence obligations remain. The adapters regroup declared content while keeping processes, actions and the same R. Shared claim types do not establish adequate meaning; possible courses certify neither actual acquisition nor duties. P76 determinacy and the claim-free Choosing boundary remain. Formal joint preservation does not complete the full wisdom root. Record non-fixation does not preserve every actual law and cannot refute the full theory. Loop certifies neither moral superiority nor an empirical social law; counterfactual reasoning is not imposed on every theoretical, contemplative or ending achievement. Fallible acceptance retains the existing epistemic candidate and its contestable commitments, not a derivation from G0 or an error bound alone. The constructed archive case supplies evidential adequacy explicitly and does not identify every reasonable belief with wisdom. False content is neither rewritten as knowledge nor automatically excused.
